content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble connecting [product_name] programming software to a [product_name] device. When I press the download button for [version_no], I get an 'Unable to access remote device' error. Could someone please assist? I'm connecting using an Ethernet cable.
What is the IP address of your computer? What is the IP address of the [product_name] device? Are you using a router, and if so, what's its IP address?
The [product_name] device is at 192.168.0.2 and the PC is at 192.168.0.1.
There is no router involved, only a direct connection from PC to [product_name] device.
Is the subnet mask the same for both devices? For instance, are both using 255.255.255.0?
Yes.
Take a look.
I can see the [product_name] device from my PC, but I can't send the program.
q
Are you able to ping the [product_name] device from your PC?
ping
I am connected to Ethernet via Wi-Fi and to the [product_name] device through an RJ-45 cable.
On your initial screenshot, the PC's IP address is displayed as 192.168.0.254, not 192.168.0.1. What are you doing with the Wi-Fi?
I'm using Wi-Fi to communicate here. I've tried both 192.168.0.254 and 192.168.0.1, but I'm not sure what to do next.
Are you certain that a router isn't present? Where are you using Wi-Fi? Can you share a screenshot of your computer's IP configuration?

Do you have the full version of [product_name] programming software or just the demo? Your computer should have a fixed IP address. The network configuration screen must show your PC in the same IP range as the [product_name] device, but not using the same IP. For example: 192.168.0.1 and both must share the same subnet. No need to set a gateway address; just leave it blank.

Do you mean the settings in the program should be: IP 192.168.0.254 and subnet 255.255.255.0; and on the PC network adapter another IP, like 192.168.0.1 and subnet 255.255.255.0; and on [product_name] device: IP 192.168.0.2, subnet 255.255.255.0, and gateway 192.168.0.1?

In my home setup there is a router (for instance, a Fritzbox). Router: IP 192.168.178.1, Subnet mask 255.255.255.0; PC: IP 192.168.178.27, Subnet mask 255.255.255.0, Gateway 192.168.178.1; [product_name] device 1: IP 192.168.178.30, Subnet mask 255.255.255.0, Gateway 192.168.178.1; [product_name] device 2: IP 192.168.178.31, Subnet mask 255.255.255.0, Gateway 192.168.178.1. The gateway address is the router's IP, and all IP addresses are static.
Is your PC connected to the router via Wi-Fi or with a wired cable?
All the devices, including the PC and [product_name] hardware, are connected by cable to the router. I've also tested wireless connections, and they worked without issues.
I am still experiencing the same issue.
Could there be a problem with the [product_name] programming software itself? I'm only waiting for the license program at the moment, and currently use the Ethernet version.
If you connect the PC directly to the [product_name] device without a router, you don't need a gateway address.
As previously asked: Do you have the full software or just the demo version? With the demo, you can create programs but cannot upload them to the [product_name] device.
Sorry for the confusion, thanks for your help. I'll reach out again once I acquire the software.

I've received the software on DVD along with instructions, but there's an issue. The instructions say to select the OS, choose the Windows version, then copy everything from the Application folder to the PC, and double-click logo.exe to start. How do you install the [product_name] programming software version 8.0? Could this be a problem with my PC?

I'm not quite following your problem at the moment. My system is Windows 7. When I insert the DVD, running autorun.inf automatically starts Setup.bat from the Windows folder on the DVD. I didn't have to copy anything; the installation is done automatically. What exactly is your issue? Can you share a screenshot of the error?
I can view the [product_name] device when going online.
I followed your steps, but the problem persists.
What is the firmware version on your [version_no]? Mine has hardware version V1.08.02 and the programming software is version 8.0.0.
For my setup: Firmware is V1.08.01; Software is V8.0.0 (2014-06-29 16:25).

Thanks, I've managed to successfully download to the [product_name] device. I selected a different (Wi-Fi) adapter and was able to connect. I needed to enter a password - 'LOGO_' - to download the program.
A new question by [user_name] has been posted in a separate thread titled 'When downloading program from PC to [product_name] device, I must input a password.' Best regards, [user_name]
A new question by [user_name] is posted in a separate thread titled 'How to download [product_name] programming software for PC (Win8)'. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having difficulties connecting [product_name] programming software on a PC directly to [product_name] hardware via Ethernet. Even with correct network configuration, the software detects the hardware but is unable to complete program downloads, resulting in an access error. The thread highlights a lack of step-by-step troubleshooting for direct PC-to-device communication.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a smooth process for transferring programs from [product_name] programming software to [product_name] hardware through direct Ethernet connection, with clear and simple troubleshooting if connectivity fails.
